_why: PR-3c v3 (W-H, SAETTA-20260915): successor of #6593/#6594, BLOCKED because certified prose still claimed openness in paraphrase the lexical detector cannot see, and a semantic read of all 59 certified capped entries (scratchpad/semantic-sweep-A/B/C.json) found 16 FALSE + 41 AMBIGUOUS sentences. This spec cures the 10 fields the Dux kept (the rest are DE-CERTIFIED, not cured, in the same PR): 21021/21022 whoThisIsFor no longer invite a foreign entrepreneur onto a 0% domestic-capital-only code; 41020's headline drops 'Open' from a 0% Koperasi/UMKM allocation; 50211/50213/65201 keep their Bali-registration pullQuote but state the national cap in the same sentence; 50223 drops 'genuinely open' for the 49% cap; 65112 states the 80% ceiling where it says registration is possible; 95291 names the Lampiran II allocation instead of asserting 'national openness'; 95299 attributes the bar to the national Lampiran II reservation, not 'Bali's PMA rules'; 25200/30400 (review MINOR) restate the Menteri Pertahanan override in the record's own kondisi wording. Whole-field replacement; every other sentence of each field is byte-identical to the live text.
